problem: BeBee's validated sweep-pollination direction requires continuous traversal, but P0 intentionally shipped no production movement controller, touch scheme or camera-follow baseline.

decision.rationale: Use one normalized direct-intent controller for keyboard and a floating touch joystick, with bounded acceleration/deceleration and bounded orthographic follow. Exact-head browser evidence proves speed parity, release behavior, native proxy/modal isolation, reduced-motion direct follow and stable representative frame pacing. The first rendered evaluation rejected an undersized bee and iterated it into the existing V-001 12-15% viewport-height band.

selected_references.name: Stardew Valley mobile invisible joystick / tap-to-move
selected_references.selection_reason: One mature top-down product exposes both floating direct control and a materially different destination/path scheme.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Invisible joystick uses a press on the movement side as a floating origin; the same documentation records blocker and precision cases for tap-to-move.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should preserve direct continuous intent for sweep traversal rather than make path ownership the primary movement abstraction.

selected_references.name: Sky: Children of the Light touch movement
selected_references.selection_reason: Touch is a first-class shipped constraint and movement/camera surfaces are separated while playfield obstruction is considered.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Touch movement activates under the thumb on a movement surface; shipped control modes account for one-/two-handed use.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should use a large unobtrusive movement acquisition surface without permanent chrome before a second gameplay action is needed.

anti_pattern.observation: Tap-to-move can stop or reroute around moving blockers and some precision cases require a joystick scheme.
anti_pattern.lesson: Destination/path ownership is a poor default for BeBee's continuous sweep movement.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Defold maps device input to named actions and dispatches through the input-focus stack; P1 must preserve the proven collection-proxy ownership path.
Single touch is available through the mouse/single-touch path with pointer coordinates; multi-touch action naming has separate constraints.
2D Camera supports orthographic projection and Auto Cover; camera game-object position can drive follow while orthographic zoom remains a multiplier.
Enabled Camera components participate in the default render pipeline, so P1 keeps a real Camera component instead of faking gameplay camera state in GUI code.

alternatives.reason: Preserves direct sweep ownership, keyboard/touch parity, deterministic tuning and future Flight headroom.
Removes intended light momentum and gives later Flight less experiential tuning space.
Adds path ownership/rerouting failure modes that conflict with continuous sweep control.
Adds snagging and cross-device tuning risk without a P1 gameplay need.
